description: The pie chart presents the distribution of emotion categories in the context of the paper “Evaluation of Speaker Anonymization on Emotional Speech,” showing 6 slices in total: Frustration (light blue) at approximately 25.1%, Neutral (purple/blue) at about 23.1%, Anger (yellow) at about 14.9%, Sadness (orange) at about 14.7%, Excitement (red) at about 14.1%, and Happiness (dark blue) at about 8.1%. Each slice contains an internal percentage label, and the category names are placed around the outside of the pie; there is no separate legend visible and no slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized. The slices appear arranged around the circle without an obvious strict ordering by size.
